name: GBA-style basic animation
whatItIs: Few-frame, snappy procedural animation for low-poly characters, time-stepped at 12 fps so it reads like sprite frames: 2-frame idle bob, 4-frame hop with squash on landing, 3-frame attack lunge, 2-frame white hit flash, 5-frame death pop. Driven by core events (attack, enemyDefeated) and position changes.
outputs: per-entity motion on the Three.js scene graph
gotchas: Godot port not written yet: the Godot template only moves entities.
Lunge offsets the entity's child node, hops move the group: models must keep their pivot at the bottom (Blender cleanup does this).
